text:
A painterly, waist-up portrait of a middle-aged woman against a softly textured gray-beige background. She faces slightly to the viewer’s right while looking directly forward with a gentle, closed-mouth smile. Her wavy brown hair, streaked with gray, is loosely braided and pinned up, with stray curls framing her face. Small leafy sprigs and pale flowers are tucked into the hair on the left side.

She wears layered, rustic clothing in muted earth tones: a gathered off-white blouse beneath a brown leather-like bodice, a dark green outer garment, and a thick, weathered olive-brown shawl draped around her shoulders. A round pendant embossed with a leafy branch hangs at her chest, and a spiral-shaped brooch fastens part of the shawl. A small bundle of green herbs and tiny pale blossoms is tucked into a pouch or pocket on her right side. The lighting is soft and warm, emphasizing the natural texture of her skin, hair, fabric, leather, and foliage.
